questions.prompt: What happens after Dewdrop asks whether the forgotten task involves the stream?
choices: Luna stops and looks at the stream.
Luna decides the task was a meeting.
Luna asks everyone to stop searching.
questions.answer: Luna stops and looks at the stream.
questions.evidenceText: Was it something to do with the Crystal Stream? asked Dewdrop. Luna stopped walking. She looked at the stream for a moment. Wait, said Luna.

questions.prompt: How do Luna's friends help solve her memory problem?
choices: Their search finds the seeds without Luna.
Their planting makes Luna forget the task.
questions.rationale: Luna says she remembered 'with help' while looking at her friends, directly linking their help to her remembering.
questions.evidenceText: I did remember, said Luna. With help. She looked at all of them. That is the point.

questions.prompt: What idea is shown when every creature plants one Moonwood seed?
choices: Caring for their shared home is everyone's job.
Luna planted every seed while the others watched.
The seeds were planted to mark the stream path.
questions.answer: Caring for their shared home is everyone's job.
questions.rationale: One planted seed from each creature shows that everyone shares the job of caring for their Moonwood home.
questions.evidenceText: They planted the seeds in a ring around the Hollow Oak. One from each of them.
